text: Test the Steel of the Northern Captains
The Northern Captains are warriors of proven merit, but strength must be demonstrated, not claimed. Defeat enemy armies in battle and show that your command is worthy of their respect.
Secure the Northern Reach
Control of territory reflects stability and authority. Expand your rule across the land and establish firm control, proving you possess the foundation required to command the Northern Captains.
Lay the Foundations of Authority
Order and governance begin with construction. Develop your lands and demonstrate your ability to strengthen and sustain the realm that the Northern Captains would defend.
Gather Proven Talent
No commander rises alone. Recruit capable individuals to your cause and show that skilled minds and loyal hands are willing to stand beneath your banner.
Claim a Realm Worth Defending
A force such as the Northern Captains does not serve minor ambitions. Expand your dominion across many regions and prove that your realm is worthy of their protection.
Crush a Rival Power
Only decisive leaders earn the loyalty of elite warriors. Eliminate a rival faction entirely, and demonstrate that you possess the resolve to remove threats without hesitation.
Secure the Granaries
Even the finest soldiers cannot march on empty stomachs. Ensure your stores are well supplied, proving that the Northern Captains would never lack provisions under your command.
Rise as a Leader of Renown
The Northern Captains follow strength tempered by experience. Elevate your leadership through deeds and command until your reputation alone demands their attention.
Command the Armies of the Realm
The Northern Captains respect leaders who already command forces of consequence. Maintain multiple armies in the field to show that you are accustomed to directing men in war.
Prove Your Worth Before the Northern Captains
Words and preparations are no longer enough. Face the Northern Captains directly in battle, and prove through force of arms that you are worthy of their allegiance.
Amass the Wealth of Command
Elite soldiers require resources beyond bravery alone. Accumulate a substantial treasury to demonstrate that you can sustain the Northern Captains in times of war and peace alike.

The Northern Captains Choose Their Commander

Trial by battle, governance, and resolve has set you apart from all rivals. The Northern Captains, long watchful within Luoyang, now acknowledge your strength and unity of command. Their banners are raised in your name, and the capital’s elite stand ready to march at your word.
